title: Sereno -Pool Heat Avail-Mins 2 Scottsdale Quarter
description: Welcome to Sereno, a luxurious retreat nestled in the heart of North Scottsdale. This stunning 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom stay offers the perfect blend of modern elegance, relaxation, and entertainment. Whether you're lounging by the private pool, enjoying the spacious interiors, or exploring the nearby top Scottsdale attractions, Sereno is the ultimate getaway. The home’s prime location places you just minutes away from some of the best dining, shopping, and golf Scottsdale has to offer.
